notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
Last Visit will be released on [b]August 19th, 2022.[/b]

Grandma Anna invites you to visit her house this vacation. Her house is in Kamby – a village full of forests, meadows, wild animals, and farms.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38855297/d5a51a53755d191e063f613853633ebcda67e691.jpg[/img]

[b]Game features:[/b]

- Atmosphere – The game has atypical lighting. The light of the flashlight resembles a flash from a phone than a standard flashlight and it causes a bigger immersion during the investigation and discovering new places.

- Random scary events – In the game, various scary sounds or monsters appear at random times and places. Thanks to this the gameplay will be a little different for each player.	

- The unique story – It is not another horror game about ghosts or an abandoned house. The story is inspired by Slavic legends where the player gathers information and put it together in a logical whole like puzzles.

- Unpredictable jumpscares – The use of jumpscares in situations that the player does not expect while maintaining logic.

- Task nonlinearity -  Some tasks you can do in a different order.

- A variety of puzzles – Each puzzle is unique and interesting.

- A variety of opponents – In the game, there are a lot of types of enemies with different levels of difficulty and various behavior. Both forest animals and bloodthirsty monsters.

- At least 4 hours of gameplay.
